name: Sharp Investments Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1977, Sharp Investments Ltd
is in the business of Investment and Loans[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SIL deals in financial service activities, except insurance and pension funding activities. It is registered as a non-systemically important non-deposit accepting NBFCs (NBFCs-ND). The 
company is primarily focused on providing inter-corporate loans, personal loans, loans against shares & securities, loans against properties, trading in shares & securities, and arbitrage business in stock and commodity markets.
